name: paranoidal-clowns
title: Paranoidal Clowns
author: FactorioParanoidal; after MadClown01's Processing, Vanilla Nuclear and AngelBob Nuclear by MadClown01 and Pezzawinkle
description: MadClown01's mods on top of Angel's in one: sand sluicing, osmium, magnesium, mercury, fluorine and phosphorus chains, uranium processing through fluorides and oxides, catalytic electrolysis, neurotoxin and garden mutation; plutonium and thorium fuel cycles, stepwise uranium enrichment instead of Kovarex, isotopes and radiothermal fuels, thermonuclear bomb and nuclear artillery shells. Replaces Clowns-Processing, Clowns-Nuclear and Clowns-AngelBob-Nuclear.
